title: Uncertainty-Masked Bernoulli Diffusion for Camouflaged Object Detection Refinement
mechanism: Estimate an uncertainty map, run Bernoulli diffusion refinement only inside uncertain regions and leave confident pixels untouched; pluggable after any encoder-decoder.
evidence: R: average gains of 5.5% MAE and 3.2% weighted F-measure across COD benchmarks with modest overhead.
adaptation: Replace their HUQNet with free 5-seed ensemble disagreement; restrict Bernoulli diffusion to a 3 px band around disagreeing crack / inactive pixels; condition on 1-ch EL and ensemble mean.
min_experiment: Arm: band-restricted Bernoulli diffusion on house ensemble. Baseline: house ensemble with val-chosen bias. Metric: crack relF1@2, IoU. Kill: relF1@2 < +0.01.

alt_notes.adaptation: Limit refinement to the uncertain 2-4 px band around predicted cracks and inactive borders, protecting the 0.93 relP@2 already reached; uncertainty from 5-seed disagreement instead of a new network.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: masked Bernoulli diffusion refiner on the uncertain band. Baseline: house ensemble. Metrics: crack IoU, relP@2 / relR@2 on 5-fold CV. Kill: crack IoU < +0.01.
